Hover Sliders

Hover-driven sliders that respond to your mouse speed! Browse images naturally with pagination, counters, and GSAP-powered transitions (gsap-aware optional feature)

Hover Image Slider

Add `data-zaiku-hover-slider` to a card with multiple `.card-slide` children. Images cycle on hover — move right for forward, left for backward. Faster movement = faster cycling.

Move to Slide

Move mouse for snappy navigation. Moving faster will slide faster!

Hover Image Slider + GSAP

When GSAP is loaded, add `data-effect` with values `fade`, `slide`, `kenburns`, `blur`, `zoom`, `rotate`, or `skew` for animated transitions. Tweens are killed and reset on each advance for snappy scrubbing.

Lazy Loading

Add `data-zaiku-lazy` and `data-src` to any element. A centered spinner shows while loading. Supports `` and `background-image` elements.

Background-image

Loaded via data-src on a div

Avatar (img tag)

data-src swaps into src on load

Lazy background

In view → loads → replaces placeholder

Custom loading SVG

data-lazy-loading replaces the default spinner
